Never publish them or commit them to a public repo. Balcony 14 (inside the parapets: x 2.442..3.295, y 0.477..6.460; house wall at x 3.295; room-4 door y 2.11..3.00, room-3 door y 3.93..4.78) and balcony 13 (x 4.176..5.058, y 9.538..12.76, quarter-circle NW corner: centre 4.9855/11.951, inner radius 0.809; living door y 9.97..10.86). x, y = footprint centre in plan metres; rot_deg = world rotation.y = plan angle CCW; the model's front (+z in the GLB) faces plan angle rot_deg - 90. dims_mm = from the product page (w x d x h; for plants w/d = foliage spread measured on the model, h = 'Înălţimea plantei' from the page). "parent" + "local" [x, bottom height, z] = stacked on another piece. "kind": "pot" is code-drawn (terracotta/anthracite pot d x h + simple foliage up to plant_h, optional flowers).
